Look<WH07200><WTH8799> not upon me, because I <FI>am<Fi> black<WH07840>, because the sun<WH08121> hath looked<WH07805><WTH8804> upon me: my mother's<WH0517> children<WH01121> were angry<WH02787><WTH8738> with me; they made<WH07760><WTH8804> me the keeper<WH05201><WTH8802> of the vineyards<WH03754>; <FI>but<Fi> mine own vineyard<WH03754> have I not kept<WH05201><WTH8804>.<CM>
